$comment: VALE team buffs (CONTRACT §5.4 camps/objectives/structures; WORLD glossary). Re-keyed 2026-10-28 (W4, originality F4): Clearglass works on your own side of the Noonline, Resinburn on the enemy side (condition selfOnSide), the Long Shade gives haste and tenacity, not attack and power; table: _design/reviews/fixwaves/W4_systems_rekey.md. A unit's onTakedownTeamBuff grants one of these to every fighter of the killing team (stats + passives) and to its Wicks (minionStats). Granting an id the team already holds refreshes its duration (sim core.ts addTeamBuff). Splinters is designed to stack to 3; the sim currently refreshes instead (SIM/LEAD request: _design/sections/modes_economy.md §10).

teamBuffs.name: Clearglass
teamBuffs.desc: From the Glasshorn, for 90 s: while on your own side of the Noonline, your whole team gains +16 ability haste and +2 resource regeneration per second.

passives.name: Clearglass
passives.desc: While you stand on your own side of the Noonline: +16 ability haste and +2 resource regeneration per second.

teamBuffs.name: Resinburn
teamBuffs.desc: From the Resinback, for 90 s: on the enemy side of the Noonline, your team's attacks stick resin to fighters and monsters (a 20% slow); your next attack on that target ignites it. Once every 4 s per target.

passives.name: Resinburn
passives.desc: On the enemy side of the Noonline, an attack on a fighter or monster sticks resin to it (20% slow for 1.5 s); your next attack on it within 4 s ignites the resin for 20 + 4 per level magic damage. Once every 4 s per target.

teamBuffs.name: Splinters
teamBuffs.desc: From the Sunsplinter, for 4:00: your team gains +5% armor and resist penetration and +5 ability haste. The next Sunsplinter you take renews it.

teamBuffs.name: The Long Shade
teamBuffs.desc: From Longshade, for 3:30: your team gains +20 ability haste and +15% tenacity. Your Wicks march tougher, harder-hitting and faster.

teamBuffs.name: Lanternwake
teamBuffs.desc: You broke an enemy Lantern. For 4:00 your Wicks on every road gain +120 health, +10 attack and +10 armor and resist.
